description:
Scans untrusted text (web page text, emails, documents, tool results, another agent's message) for prompt injection before your agent acts on it: instruction overrides, jailbreak personas, system-prompt extraction, fake delimiters, exfiltration URLs, tool hijacking, hidden Unicode, encoded payloads. Deterministic rules; up to 100000 characters. Returns risk_score (0-100), verdict (safe | suspicious | malicious), categories[] and findings[]. Free: 30 calls/day per IP shared with scan_url and scan_tools.
Not for: links (use scan_url) or MCP tool definitions (use scan_tools). A safety signal, not a guarantee.

[InjectScan via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as InjectScan's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: scan $0.003 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

text.description: The untrusted text to scan, as one plain string (1-100000 characters; longer text is truncated and flagged). Offsets in findings refer to this string.

tier.description: Paid tier: scan $0.003. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

items.description: A tool definition: name, description and inputSchema (MCP tools/list or OpenAI/Anthropic shape).
